title: The day after
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Monday after the bus. The strip's town is one block wide. The frame shop is normal size.

panels.composition: Main street, Monday morning, drawn one block wide: the panel is a narrow vertical slot. WOOD walking to work with BARNABY.

image.prompt: a small-town main street compressed into a narrow vertical slot of a panel, a young man walking a small dog through it in rain, brush-pen black and white
image.notes: Panel 1 is the narrowest panel of the arc — a slot. Panels 2–4 are normal width; the strip's grid is asymmetric this day.

panels.composition: The frame shop. Normal width. The OWNER handing him a job ticket. The mat cutter.

balloons.text: Diploma. Coos Bay. Double mat, cream and green.

image.prompt: a woman in reading glasses handing a job ticket to a young man at a frame-shop counter

panels.composition: Wood cutting. Clean forty-five. The hands don't shake.

image.prompt: close-up of steady hands guiding a mat cutter through a clean corner

panels.composition: The dog under the mat table. Wood above. The ticket says Coos Bay. Wood, to the dog: nothing. The strip goes back to being a strip.

image.prompt: a young man working at a mat table with a small dog underneath, a job ticket pinned beside him, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Arc 1 closes. The narrow panel is used once more and retired.
